NewsArticle.Title: Salachar
NewsArticle.Content:
Unregistered players who consistently abuse others to the point of being exiled by a player politician are now not only removed from that realm, but are removed from all realms. They become citizens of the realm of Salachar (gaelic for 'filth'). They may not leave this one-roomed realm, nor communicate from it (including speaking, whispering, or writing mail) unless the exile is forgiven and the player re-admitted.
An unregistered player who is banished (much less permanent than exile) from a realm by a player guard is placed in Salachar for a real life day.
Temuair is a beautiful world of imagination that flourishes and blossoms with Aislings. You're in your world now.
See [political features](http://www.darkages.com/2000/play/s_politics.html) screenshot and all [features.](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/index_feature.html)
